title: Mortgage lenders in Israel: official mortgage site and phone numbers as published on each bank's own website
method: Plain HTTPS GET with a normal browser user agent; static HTML read (no JavaScript). Phone numbers copied only from the bank's own pages listed in source_page. No third-party site used. Raw copies in gov/raw/banks/.

phones.purpose: מידע ושירות למשכנתא קיימת (לקוחות בעלי חשבון משכנתא בלבד)
לקוחות בעלי חשבון עו"ש וחשבון משכנתא בלאומי

banks.digital_evidence: https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/all-about-mortgage/category/about/digital-mortgage : apply digitally only, or finish the whole process digitally and sign remotely

phones.hours: Sun-Thu 08:30-17:00; Fri and holiday eves closed
Sun-Thu 08:30-15:30; Fri and holiday eves closed

banks.digital_evidence: https://www.bankhapoalim.co.il/mortgage/digital-mortgage : online application, Zoom meeting after approval in principle, no branch visit; portal https://mortgage.bankhapoalim.co.il/ng-portals/dm/he/lobby

phones.purpose: בירור או עדכון לגבי משכנתא קיימת
מומחי טפחות למשכנתא חדשה (as quoted on Bank Yahav's page)

banks.digital_evidence: https://www.mizrahi-tefahot.co.il/mortgages/takemortgagelib/mortgage-app/ (Tefahot Touch app); the mortgages page offers an online offer request and a digital refinance request
banks.note: Mortgage-specific line is extension 4 of the main number *8860; the hours above are as printed for each extension.

banks.digital_evidence: Same page: 'איך מגישים בקשה דיגיטלית למשכנתא?' and the online offer flow ('מבקשים הצעה, מקבלים אישור עקרוני'). Also linked from https://www.discountbank.co.il/private/mortgage/

banks.note: The mortgage site's own contact page (/contact-us) returned 404 and its phone, if any, is loaded by JavaScript. Mortgage-line number: unverified.

banks.digital_evidence: https://www.bankotsar.co.il/private/loansandmortgages/mortgages/digitalmor/ : digital application for customers of all banks, 18+, Israeli residents (form at https://apps.fibi.co.il/digmo/)
Same page: 'הגשת בקשה למשכנתא בדיגיטל'; links to https://mortgage.fibi.co.il/digmo/
Same page: customers of all banks over 18 can apply for a mortgage online, no current account needed

phones.purpose: מומחי טפחות למשכנתא (Yahav refers mortgage customers to Mizrahi-Tefahot)

banks.digital_evidence: Same page links Tefahot's online mortgage form https://sc.mizrahi-tefahot.co.il/TofesMashkantaClient/
banks.note: Yahav does not present its own mortgage product: 'משכנתא בטפחות... בחלק מסניפי בנק יהב תוכלו לפנות למומחים של טפחות'. The URL https://www.bank-yahav.co.il/mortgage/ answered 'Request Rejected' (web firewall); not retried.
Blocked: Cloudflare challenge ('Just a moment', HTTP 403). Not bypassed. Whether it offers mortgages: unverified.

not_checked: Banks that no longer exist as separate mortgage lenders (Union Bank, Discount Mortgage Bank) and non-bank lenders were not checked. Bank Esh was not checked.
